scope: Bounded source/claim/context audit under mission plan v2; no new universal cipher-family rejection.
method: Refresh upstream heads without replacing historical pinned clones. Record identical heads rather than claiming new versions.
Discovery searches across priority texts, official/creator evidence, lore anchors, matrix history, published algorithms, forums and videos. Follow primary citations in a second pass.
Distinguish search snippets, read documents, primary/copy provenance and inaccessible material. Do not claim a video scene from a title.
Inspect before executing selected upstream code. Reproduce a concrete phrase-codebook claim and a concrete nontextual-origin claim if runnable evidence exists; otherwise record why not.
Independent checks must distinguish hardcoded/inferred labels from external plaintext, and exact reconstruction from proof of authorial intent.
Freeze each new numerical test specification before running its target comparison; paired nulls preserve the properties relevant to that test.
Publish short attributed excerpts/analytical metadata and licensed small code fixtures only; keep third-party page bodies and full repo clones local.
closure: One source round with scoped decisions, unresolved sources and explicit triggers for R25/R26; no unbounded search for attractive English.
candidate_policy: Literal outputs with provenance and status; a published translation remains unverified unless its algorithm predicts independently authenticated content.
